stem: One mole of a purple coloured complex \(\mathrm{CoCl_3}\) and \(\mathrm{NH_3}\) on treatment with excess \(\mathrm{AgNO_3}\) produces two moles \(\mathrm{AgCl}\). Write the formula of the complex if the coordination number of \(\mathrm{Co}\) is 6.
solution: One mole of the complex gives 2 moles of \(\mathrm{AgCl}\). It indicates that two \(\mathrm{Cl^{\ominus}}\) ions react with \(\mathrm{Ag^{\oplus}}\) ions. The complex has two ionisable \(\mathrm{Cl^{\ominus}}\) ions. The formula of the complex is then \(\mathrm{[Co(NH_3)_5Cl]Cl_2}\).
